property_summary: After a non-owner calls AdjustBetAmounts, the contract should revert (i.e., openToPublic should remain unchanged).
After a non-owner calls AdjustBetAmounts, OpenToThePublic should remain unchanged (i.e., openToPublic stays false).
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the openToThePublic state variable should remain unchanged.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, openToThePublic remains unchanged regardless of who calls it.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called by any address, the openToPublic state variable should remain unchanged and keep its initial value false.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, the betLimit state variable equals the amount passed as argument.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the betLimit state variable equals the amount that was passed as argument.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the betLimit is not set to zero when a non-zero amount is provided.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the betLimit state variable equals the amount passed as argument.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount) reverts if the caller is not the owner, otherwise the returned value from currentBetLimit() equals the amount passed.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, reading currentDifficulty returns the same value as before the call.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the difficulty returned by currentDifficulty is unchanged from before the call.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, currentDifficulty() always returns zero.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, currentDifficulty() returns the same value as before the call.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, the difficulty value returned by currentDifficulty is unchanged from its value before the call.
After AdjustBetAmounts changes the bet limit, the wager function should accept exactly the new bet limit, not bet limit plus one.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new bet limit, the wager function reverts when msg.value is bet limit plus one.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new bet limit, wager succeeds when msg.value equals the new bet limit and fails when msg.value is the new bet limit plus one.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new bet limit, wager always succeeds with msg.value equal to the new bet limit and always reverts with msg.value equal to the new bet limit plus one.
When the contract is open to the public, a call to wager with msg.value equal to the current betLimit succeeds, but with msg.value equal to betLimit+1 reverts.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a new bet limit, the contract's wager mapping for a caller who then calls wager() should reflect the exact amount sent.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a new bet limit, the contract's betLimit state variable equals the amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts.
After AdjustBetAmounts, a player's wager amount recorded in the contract equals the value they sent when calling wager.
After the owner adjusts the bet limit, the balance of the whale address should not decrease due to a player's wager call.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the wager stored for a player equals the value they sent to wager().
After a call to AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's eth balance remains unchanged by a subsequent call to donate().
After AdjustBetAmounts, a subsequent call to donate() with the same amount should increase totalDonated by that amount.
After a call to AdjustBetAmounts, a subsequent call to donate() should always increase totalDonated by the sent msg.value.
After a call to AdjustBetAmounts, calling donate() with a non-zero value should increase the contract's totalDonated state.
After any sequence of public calls ending with AdjustBetAmounts, a subsequent call to donate() with any msg.value does not increase totalDonated.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance equals its balance before that call.
After a call to AdjustBetAmounts, the totalDonated state variable (observed through the donate function) should remain unchanged.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance remains unchanged.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance does not decrease.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance is unchanged from before the call.
After adjusting the bet amount, the donate function should not revert when called by any address.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, calling donate with any positive value does not revert.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance does not increase when donate is called with any positive value.
After AdjustBetAmounts, calling donate from any address with any amount does not revert

After calling AdjustBetAmounts, calling donate from any address with any amount should not revert and the contract's balance should decrease by the donated amount (since it is forwarded to the whale).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance() returns a positive value.
After any AdjustBetAmounts call, ethBalance returns the same value as address(this).balance.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a non-zero amount, ethBalance() returns at least that amount.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's ethBalance() equals its actual ether balance.
After AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance returns the original contract balance before the call.
The ethBalance() function returns the contract's actual balance, not plus one wei.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance() returns a value that is exactly divisible by 2 (i.e., even).
The ethBalance() return value does not change when only AdjustBetAmounts is called (no ETH sent).
ethBalance() returns a value whose least significant bit equals 0 (i.e., it is even) when the contract balance is updated correctly.

ethBalance() always returns a value that is congruent to the actual contract balance modulo 2, i.e., (ethBalance() % 2) == ((address(c).balance) % 2). The bug makes it return (actualBalance + 1), flipping the parity.
For any address and any bet limit, after calling AdjustBetAmounts, calling ethBalance returns half the contract balance if the bug is present, but the correct contract balance otherwise.
The ethBalance() function returns the full contract balance before any division.
ethBalance() returns exactly address(this).balance (no division).
The ethBalance() function returns exactly address(this).balance (no division).

After AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance() returns a value that is either the full balance or half the balance; but the reference always returns the full balance, while the mutant returns half the balance when the balance is even.
After adjusting the betting amount, the current difficulty should differ from half of it, but the buggy version makes them equal.

After AdjustBetAmounts changes the bet limit, the value returned by currentDifficulty() is exactly twice the value when called with the new bet limit as argument in the reference, but the buggy version returns the same value for both calls.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, currentDifficulty() should not be half of the bet limit, but the buggy version always returns half of it.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the currentDifficulty() should not be equal to half of AdjustBetAmounts's argument for all possible inputs, but the buggy version always does.
Setting the bet limit via AdjustBetAmounts should not affect the difficulty value returned by currentDifficulty.
After adjusting the bet limit via AdjustBetAmounts, the value returned by currentBetLimit() equals the value that was just set.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a given amount, the value returned by currentBetLimit() should be strictly less than the amount plus two.
The return value of currentBetLimit() should not exceed the value set by AdjustBetAmounts.
After adjusting the bet limit via AdjustBetAmounts, the value returned by currentBetLimit() equals the value that was just set plus one.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts(a), currentBetLimit() returns a
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount) is called, the return value of currentBetLimit() should equal the last value passed to AdjustBetAmounts.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount), currentBetLimit() returns a value that is at least as large as the betLimit used to wager (which is the amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts).
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the return value of currentBetLimit() is consistent with the amount passed (positive or zero), and specifically equals amount when amount is non-zero.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) with a non-zero amount, currentBetLimit() should return a positive value (since it returns the set bet limit, not zero).
The return value of currentBetLimit() equals the last positive amount set by AdjustBetAmounts(amount).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, currentBetLimit() returns the value last set by AdjustBetAmounts, not the contract balance.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts to a value X, currentBetLimit() returns X, not the contract balance.
After adjusting the bet limit to a given amount, calling currentBetLimit() returns that same amount regardless of the contract's balance.
The currentBetLimit value before and after a AdjustBetAmounts call should be consistent with the last set value, regardless of any unrelated state changes like balance.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets the bet limit to a value, currentBetLimit() returns that value independent of any balance changes.
Adjusting betLimit should change currentBetLimit() to the new value, which fails when the getter returns difficulty instead.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a non-zero value, currentBetLimit() should return that value and be independent of any subsequent difficulty changes.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount) is called, currentBetLimit() returns the same value as the amount argument, regardless of subsequent difficulty changes.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount) is called, currentBetLimit() returns a value equal to the last amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts, independent of any other state changes.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a non-zero value, currentBetLimit() returns the same value as the last AdjustBetAmounts argument, regardless of subsequent difficulty changes.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount), currentBetLimit() returns the previously set amount, not 0.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called with a non-zero amount, currentBetLimit() returns a value greater than zero.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the value returned by currentBetLimit() equals the just-set amount.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount), currentBetLimit() returns a value that is never 0 when amount is non-zero.
Calling AdjustBetAmounts with any non-zero amount causes currentBetLimit to return the same non-zero value.
After AdjustBetAmounts, hasPlayerWagered returns false for any address that never wagered.
For any address that has wagered, hasPlayerWagered should return true.
After AdjustBetAmounts(uint256), the return value of hasPlayerWagered(address player) is the same before and after the call for all addresses that have never wagered.
After AdjustBetAmounts(uint256), hasPlayerWagered(address) returns the opposite of whether wagers[address] is zero.
The return value of hasPlayerWagered(address) should be consistent with whether the player has ever made a wager that has not been cleared by play().
The winnersPot() function returns exactly half the contract balance.
winnersPot() does not exceed the ETH balance of the contract at full precision.
winnersPot() returns at most half of the contract's ETH balance
Calling AdjustBetAmounts does not change the value returned by winnersPot()
Calling AdjustBetAmounts does not change the ratio of winnersPot() to the contract balance.
